item.description:
Launchpad 0.3.8

  • Native visual-language pass: SF Pro typography instead of rounded custom fonts.
  • Semantic primary/secondary colors and system materials replace decorative blue borders, hand-drawn icons and colored gradients.
  • Neutral selection, folder, empty-state and drop-target surfaces; softer native shadows.
  • Search uses native SF Symbols with a standard 40pt control and semantic placeholder color.
